cells.description: Hydroponic shed sunk into the ground: a low roof ridge with two amber grow-light skylights above grade, earth banked up all four sides (owner: "embed them into the earth"). The bank is shading only, so it takes the planet's ground. Walkable earth mound: light cover, half height 0.18; vehicles pass.
cells.name: doodad.hydro-shed

cells.description: The sunken shed half as long, to end a row or fill a short plot. Walkable earth mound: light cover, half height 0.18.
cells.name: doodad.hydro-shed-short

cells.description: Pump house: water and nutrient tanks, pump and header pipe on a skid, ending a shed row.
cells.name: doodad.hydro-pumphouse
